agenda_text:
HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 06/04/14 - 7PM
HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 06/04/14 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
JUNE 04, 2014
05:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 103
SPECIAL MEETING
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, THOMPSON, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. ((Voice Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
4. CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
5. CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1 Approval to Increase the Amount of an Affordable Housing Rental Rehabilitation Loan by and Between the Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale and Joseph Estes and Elsie Estes for Veterans Housing, authorize Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents, funded through multiple accounts. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
HA 5.1
5.2 Approval of Agreement with Iron Built, Inc. for the Rehabilitation of 38464 30th Street East (APN 3021-028-900) for $8,618.18 to prepare the property for sale, authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents for the rehabilitation and sale of the property, funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-4730. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
HA 5.2
5.3 Approval of Agreement with Iron Built, Inc. for the Rehabilitation of 38627 32nd Street East (APN 3021-005-016) for $46,547.29 as part of the Neighborhood Improvement Program in Focus Neighborhood No. 5, authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents, funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-4731. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
HA 5.3
5.4 Approve the minutes from the previous meetings held March 5, 2014 (7PM), April 2, 2014 (7PM), and May 7, 2014 (6PM). (Staff Reference: Authority Secretary Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
HA 5.4
6. JOINT PUBLIC HEARING OF THE CITY COUNCIL (ITEM NO. 8.1), SUCCESSOR AGENCY (ITEM NO. 6.1 ), HOUSING AUTHORITY (ITEM 6.1), INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1), PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1), PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1), PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY (ITEM NO. 5.1 ). (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
6.1 ADOPT JOINT RESOLUTION NOS. CC 2014-076, SA 2014-010, PCA 2014-001, HA 2014-004, IDA 2014-001, PAA 2014-001, AND PFA 2014-001, A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE , THE INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, THE PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, AND THE PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE CITY OF PALMDALE'S BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2014-15 AND APPROVING REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE ADJUSTMENTS TO FISCAL YEAR 2013-14.
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Joint Resolution Nos. CC 2014-076, SA 2014-010, PCA 2014-001, HA 2014-004, IDA 2014-001, PAA 2014-001, and PFA 2014-001. (Voice Vote - requires a majority to adopt.)
HA 6.1
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. HOUSING AUTHORITY CLOSED SESSION - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
9. PRESENTATION BY AUTHORITY ATTORNEY of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
9.1 The reason for holding a closed session, is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the Authority's legal counsel and to receive direction from the Housing Authority regarding the possible initiation of litigation by the Housing Authority.
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.9(c). Number of cases - One. Possible initiation of litigation regarding the Department of Finance's denial of housing administrative cost allowance.
Closed session is recommended because the Housing Authority will assess the merits of this matter and consider the Housing Authority's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the Authority Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the Housing Authority to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case; such disclosure may harm settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
10. HOUSING AUTHORITY CLOSED SESSION.
11. ANNOUNCEMENT BY AUTHORITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
12. ADJOURNMENT.
